pages.text: Activated Fractionator: $(4)1 activated crystal → 1 matching activated component + 1 exhausted crystal$(0).$(br2)Each cut costs 2,000 energy and takes 100 ticks.$(br2)Components are the food of the $(l:akaishi:plasma_aggregator)Fusion Fuel Aggregator$(/l).

$(bold)Don't toss the exhausted crystals:$(0)$(4)entry reforging and item reconstruction both demand them$(0) — covered in "Secrets of Life".$(br2)Activated crystals themselves come from the exhausted-fuel activator → centrifuge route, also in "Secrets of Life" — read the two books side by side.
Chain overview in $(l:akaishi:plasma)Plasma Chain$(/l); hand the components to the $(l:akaishi:plasma_aggregator)Fusion Fuel Aggregator$(/l).
